topic: GameStop's 2021 short squeeze made a few people millions and wiped out most who bought in after the spike
title: How Most GameStop Investors Actually Lost Money
description:
The 2021 GameStop short squeeze made headlines about ordinary people getting rich. The reality is that for every winner, there were dozens who bought at the top and lost nearly everything. Here's why the hype is always the trap.

#gamestop #investing #personalfinance #stockmarket #shortsqueeze
